messages:
sanjay_pm: FYI — PRD v0.3 is up: https://redwood.docs/prd/sync-reroute-v0.3. Need cross-team alignment on scope + acceptance criteria. Major customer (Acme) asked for synchronous reroute. Question: ship sync reroute in M1 or push to M2? Looking for blockers and stakeholder +1s by EOD Fri.

elaine_prod: Reading now. Quick note: product priority is reducing tail latency for hosted API. If sync reroute materially increases p99 or cost, prefer M2 unless Acme contract requires M1.

matt_eng: Quick perf take — sync reroute implies extra routing logic + more KV hops; estimated +10–20% p99 on back-to-back requests for 512 token flows. Also needs dedicated path (cannot safely run on low-tier shared pool). We'll need canary on Dedicated. @sanjay_pm what's our p99 target?

sanjay_pm: Target p99 <= 350ms for common workloads (512 tokens). If we can't meet that we fallback to async path. I've added preliminary acceptance criteria in the PRD but please comment.

carla_cs: From Acme: they need near real-time (<500ms) for 90% of requests. They can accept async for long contexts. They'll pay for Dedicated if that gets them GA in Q2, but timeline is tight.

anya_design: Edge cases to call out: 1) fallback path changes response schema (function-calling / structured output) -> client confusion. 2) Partial results ordering when KV cache hit/miss. I'll add UI wording + a small microflow for error states: 'Delayed — will be delivered via callback'.

taylor_research: Add evaluation acceptance too: run top-50 customer prompt set against baseline. Block if quality-drift > 3% on key metrics (e.g., exact-match / intent). I'll draft the eval harness.

deploy-bot: CI check: PRD lint pass OK. Integration tests missing: load-test scenario #12 (sync-reroute heavy). See https://ci.redwood/status/5678.

matt_eng: Concrete action items from eng: 1) define canary plan (5% traffic on Dedicated), 2) implement routing policy + metrics (p50/p95/p99, error-rate, cost-per-token), 3) perf budget and rollback criteria. I can own canary work if @elaine_prod OKs.

elaine_prod: +1 for @matt_eng to own canary. We need a smoke dashboard (p99, error-rate, cost/token, quality-drift). Ops/console should have alert thresholds. :thumbsup:

sanjay_pm: Updating PRD checklist. Draft checklist snippet added below, please review: ```- Canary on Dedicated (5% traffic)
- Monitor: p99, error-rate, cost-per-token, quality-drift on seed prompts
- Rollback conditions: p99 > 500ms for 5m or quality-drift > 3%
- QA: run top-50 prompt regression before canary
- UX: explicit client callback state and schema compatibility test```

carla_cs: CS will confirm with Acme whether they can relax the GA date by 2 weeks if we need an extra perf cycle. I'll update here after the call (tmw morning PT).

anya_design: I'll drop mock screenshots and schema examples into the PRD (section: "schema compatibility") by EOD.

 taylor_research: I'll share the eval harness + seed prompts by tomorrow noon UTC. Will include a small script to compute quality-drift.

sanjay_pm: Final ask: can everyone +1 the checklist by 2027-04-05 18:00 UTC so I can lock scope and hand off to eng? @matt_eng @elaine_prod @carla_cs

matt_eng: +1 pending perf budget doc (I'll post an initial draft today).

elaine_prod: +1 for scope and canary plan.

carla_cs: +1 from CS contingent on Acme contract confirmation.

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: doc review follow-up set for 2027-04-06 16:00 UTC.
